"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using the pdf skill (reportlab + pypdf)."""
import datetime
import os

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# 1. Create the cover page PDF
cover_path = "cover.pdf"
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 10, today)

# Decorative line
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 - 40, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 - 40)
c.save()

# 2. Merge: cover page first, then the original report
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
writer = PdfWriter()

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])

for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print("Done! Created report_with_cover.pdf with cover page.")
print("Cover title: Annual Financial Report")
print("Cover date:", today)
print("Original report pages:", len(reader.pages))
print("Total pages in output:", len(writer.pages))
